sequential_dependency.intermediate: The selected run start together with the layer suffix beginning at that input-dependent depth.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Read the stripe colors, form maximal constant runs, and choose the start index of the earliest longest run.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Use that suffix as outside-to-inside colors and render an even concentric square by minimum distance to an output edge.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The selected start fixes both the output side length and every layer lookup; stage B cannot choose its canvas or color sequence before stage A returns the suffix.

parametric_work.summary: Exact canonical program plus a source-bound longest-run-suffix branch, 2–6 demos, four private queries, protected official/generated execution, causal replay, and bounded export/privacy audit.

target.summary: Authored and verified a complete public-creation family: solid stripe colors become concentric square layers; a longest-run-suffix setting supplies a real input-dependent rival.
